history.name: 00-brand-system
history.prompt: Use case: logo-brand / ui-mockup. Premium polished videogame UI concept for Virtual Runners, a joyful 1990s anime side-scrolling runner with existing cel-painted chibi characters. Brand '晴空跑道': bright open SKY, CLOUD WHITE and SUNSHINE ORANGE. Palette #23B5E8, #116F95, #FF8A3D, #FFFFFF, #ECF8FC, dark text #163A4B, reward yellow #F5C949. Rounded wayfinding signs, circular route nodes, pill-shaped distance markers, thin deep-lake-blue outlines and soft short shadows. Clear spacious hierarchy, large readable Traditional Chinese, functional consistent UI. Flat cel colors, no chrome or metallic letters, no black brush panels, no volleyball/sports-team shield, no navy-gold theme, no app-store ad/purchases, no floating confetti everywhere. Clean typography, no illegible tiny labels. Full-bleed landscape 16:9 screen, preferably 1920x1080 or higher, no device frame. Create a single professional BRAND AND UI COMPONENT CONCEPT BOARD on pale sky-white background. Top 55%: a large bespoke CHINESE LOGO reading exactly '虛擬跑跑樂' with smaller 'VIRTUAL RUNNERS' below. 虛擬 is smaller but readable, 跑跑樂 large round chunky upright playful lettering, first 跑 orange, second 跑 cyan, 樂 orange, subtle step-height stagger suggesting running. Thin deep blue contour with white negative spaces, flat two-tone shading, NO yellow metallic bevel, no orbit swoosh or enclosing badge. Tiny jump arc with two round route nodes above the two 跑, never crosses glyphs. Leave airy whitespace. Bottom 45% neatly arranged UI component samples with clear gutters: orange rounded primary button '開始跑' dark ink text with right arrow; white/blue selected button '關卡模式' with focus ring and pointer; muted locked node with lock icon; heart trio; gold coin count '042'; small route line linking numbered circular nodes '1-1' '1-2' '1-3' and a finish flag. Along bottom a tasteful six-color palette strip using cyan, deep lake blue, orange, white, pale sky, dark ink. Components feel like friendly route signs, no character illustration necessary. The title logo is the hero and all samples share one coherent system. Beautiful finished design presentation, NOT sketch, no explanatory paragraphs.
